what_it_is.prose: Adani Defence & Aerospace is the defence vertical of Adani Enterprises Ltd (BSE/NSE: ADANIENT), headquartered at Adani Corporate House in Shantigram, Ahmedabad. Adani Defence itself is not separately listed; its financials are embedded within AEL's 'Others' segment and are not separately disclosed. The division's flagship counter-UAS programme is the Adani-DRDO Vehicle-Mounted Counter-Drone System unveiled at Aero India 2025 on 11 February 2025 under a DRDO Transfer of Technology framework. The system is a 4x4 platform integrating a high-energy laser, 7.62 mm gun, radar, SIGINT, EO/IR sensors, and jammers, with a reported 10 km range. Other major programmes include the Kanpur ammunition manufacturing complex (South Asia's largest, on a 500-acre site, with capacity scaling to 300 million small-calibre rounds by December 2025); the SR-1 loitering munition (displayed at Defence & Security 2025 in November 2025, with a 1 kg HE warhead, 45-minute endurance, and 4,500 m ceiling); a helicopter ecosystem MoU with Leonardo (Italy) signed on 3 February 2026 covering AW169M and AW109 TrekkerM final assembly, MRO, and pilot training in India; the Drishya and Drishti UAV family (with STANAG 4671 certification, in service with the Indian Navy); and the ULM-ER ULPGM V3 UAV-launched precision-guided munition. Adani Defence operates India's first private-sector small arms manufacturing facility. The division's CEO is Ashish Rajvanshi.

deployments_procurement.summary: Adani Defence's counter-UAS work is anchored by the Adani-DRDO Vehicle-Mounted CUAS unveiled at Aero India 2025 on 11 February 2025. Production order status and customer identity for the Vehicle-Mounted CUAS have not been disclosed. The Kanpur ammunition complex is operational and supplies the Ministry of Defence and export markets. The Leonardo helicopter MoU is pre-contract (signed 3 February 2026).

faq.question: What is the Adani-DRDO Vehicle-Mounted Counter-Drone System?
faq.answer: The Adani-DRDO Vehicle-Mounted Counter-Drone System was unveiled at Aero India 2025 on 11 February 2025 under a DRDO Transfer of Technology framework. The system is a 4x4 platform integrating a high-energy laser, 7.62 mm gun, radar, SIGINT, EO/IR sensors, and jammers, with a reported 10 km range. Production order status and customer identity have not been publicly disclosed as of August 2026.

faq.question: What is the Kanpur ammunition complex and why is it significant?
faq.answer: The Adani Defence Kanpur ammunition manufacturing complex, inaugurated on 26 February 2024, is South Asia's largest ammunition facility, spanning 500 acres. Capacity is scaling to 300 million small-calibre rounds, 30 million artillery rounds, and millions of grenades per year by December 2025. The complex serves both Ministry of Defence requirements and export markets, and represents a major private-sector entry into ammunition manufacturing — historically a PSU monopoly.

faq.question: Is Bhargavastra made by Adani Defence?
faq.answer: No. Bhargavastra is designed and developed by Solar Defence and Aerospace Limited (SDAL), a subsidiary of Solar Group / Solar Industries India Limited of Nagpur — not by Adani Defence. The Atlas register's attribution of Bhargavastra to 'Big Bang Boom Solutions' is also incorrect; all credible 2025-26 sources attribute it to SDAL. Adani Defence's counter-UAS work is anchored by the Adani-DRDO Vehicle-Mounted CUAS (Aero India 2025).
